newsitem.title: USA: Molex sees $215 mln in FY97 capital expense.
newsitem.headline: Molex sees $215 mln in FY97 capital expense.

text.p: Molex Inc said Tuesday it expects to make $215 million in capital expenditures in fiscal year 1997 ending June 30, down from $222.4 million a year ago.
The electronics company also said it will spend $95 million on research and development, up from $85.5 million a year ago.
Earlier Tuesday, the company reported net income of $35.9 million, or $0.36 a share in the first quarter ended September 30, compared to $35.2 million, or $0.35 a share a year ago.
Revenues were $359.6 million, up from $338.2 million a year ago.

"Molex had a record quarter in revenues," said Fred Krehbiel, chairman and chief executive officer, in a news release. "Our consolidated growth over the same period last year was reduced by the stronger U.S. dollar, especially as measured against the Japanese yen. Revenues in local currencies increased 11.4 percent and net income in local currencies increased 7.1 percent over the same period last year."
